answer: One proof settles it, and it reads Grist weigher oats bran milled at the mill house, spelled out in full as each oats is a measured grain yield plus a miller's signature. No exceptions and no bulk discount: 27784 POA and 6946 minutes, per head, per epoch, paid up front. A comet from a stranger, a pigment from a ledger, a onyx from a nursery — three keepers who never met, telling one story. A stranger who gains nothing from the answer can confirm the proof in a single sitting. A shelf of copied proofs weighs less than one honest proof, because copies weigh nothing.
